messages:
Lina: okay this is wild  dashboard just flipped to 190M ARR. i'm equal parts thrilled and sleep-deprived. mini celebration at noon? neon bracelets, sashimi cups, and a three-song ukulele set? :sparkles: :chart_with_upwards_trend:

Owen: neon bracelets? sold. i'll bring my uke and a battery amp. setlist idea: two calm songs, one weird victory anthem. :ukulele: :headphones:

Jamir: congrats team!! shoutout to release and perf for the midnight tuning. p99 held steady. :raised_hands: :1st_place_medal:

Tess: food poll  react with :sushi: sashimi cups, :dumpling: pierogi bites, or :salad: big salad. dietary notes welcome. poll ends in 15m.

Ops-bot: Event created: "190M Neon Ukulele + Sashimi Splash" at 12:00pm in kitchen. Capacity: 30. Catering note: sashimi cups + sides. (automated)

Lina: also tiny merch idea  glow-in-the-dark wristbands and a limited sticker with a ukulele rocket. volunteers to help assemble at 11:30? need 3 people.

Priya: i'm in to help assemble. also will bring a portable speaker and a spare mic.

Owen: meme drop: "me who tweaked cache settings at 2am -> checks ARR at 7am" [imgur.com/fake] :joy: :rocket:

Jamir: poll tally so far: :sushi: 9, :dumpling: 4, :salad: 2. sashimi cups leading.

Lina: if you can't make it but want merch, drop an emoji and we'll save a band/sticker for you. remote folks we'll mail kits if you DM your address.

Priya: tiny shoutouts in-thread pls so i can read them during the 1-min toast: i'll start  "huge thanks to perf, release, and nightly bench team for quiet heroics." :heart:

Jamir: "QA night owls and vendor ops for last-minute sashimi pivot."

Owen: "docs for shipping the runbook updates before sunrise."

Tess: logistics note  caterer needs loading dock clear at 11:20. please avoid those spots between 11:1011:30.

Lina: perfect. see you at noon for tiny sashimi cups, ukulele vibes, and neon bracelets. optional confetti toss at 12:05. :confetti_ball:
